title: Cross-host native send reports notificationDisposition "durableButNotWoken" although the remote recipient is woken and takes a turn within seconds
outcome: Cross-host native send reports notificationDisposition "durableButNotWoken" although the remote recipient is woken and takes a turn within seconds
acceptance: The cause is identified from source: why a native termal_send_to_session from Central to host:<satellite>::session-N, resolved into a relay mailbox, reports durableButNotWoken at send time while the satellite home delivers a wake to that session.

The send receipt reports the wake outcome truthfully: either it carries the home's actual wake result when the relay reply includes it, or it reports an explicitly unknown/pending wake state (not "not woken") when the sender cannot know; an exact read of the message afterwards reflects the home's recorded wake state when available.
Behaviour tests cover a cross-host send whose home wakes the recipient (receipt and later read do not claim not-woken) and one whose home genuinely does not wake it (still reported as not woken).
